title: Personal Injury Professionals Networking Mixer
summary: The August stop on the monthly mixer circuit. Waterfront patio, open conversation, and the usual mix of attorneys, providers, and partners from across Broward.
description: The monthly mixer moves to Fort Lauderdale for August. Same format that works every month: a welcoming room, a drink in your hand, and no one running a structured networking exercise at you.
If it's your first MMG event, find Andrew at the door. He'll make two or three introductions based on who you're trying to meet, and the rest takes care of itself.
First round and passed appetisers are covered by our sponsors. Parking is validated in the marina lot.

comments.author: Elena Vasquez
comments.body: Bringing two associates who just moved over from defense work. Great room for them to meet providers.

comments.author: Nadia Farouk
comments.body: Is the patio covered? Last August we got caught in a downpour at the Weston one and everyone ended up inside.

comments.author: Andrew Miller
comments.body: Covered patio plus the private room inside — we have both this time. No repeat of Weston.

comments.author: Terrence Booker
comments.body: First one for me. Anyone else coming solo? Happy to meet at the bar beforehand so we're not both standing there.
